_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/modes/test_x_sized_mode_targets.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_profane_command` is Profane Command: four bullets, each owning a target, two of them reading the announced X -- 'up to X target creatures' (an X-sized mode-owned spec) and 'creature card with mana value X or less' (a mode-owned selector reading X). `t_heliod_intervention` is Heliod's Intervention: 'destroy X target artifacts and/or enchantments', exactly X, owned by the first bullet.

cards.name: Test Profane Command
cards.oracle_text:
Choose two —
• Target player loses X life.
• Return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
• Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.
• Up to X target creatures gain fear until end of turn.

modes.label: Return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.
Up to X target creatures gain fear until end of turn.

cards.oracle_text:

• Destroy X target artifacts and/or enchantments.
• Target player gains twice X life.
